summary: Classifies locomotion state by watching the controller. Purely observational, never drives movement.
overview: Watches an existing KinematicCharacterController's velocity and grounded flag, plus an optional LedgeClimbController, and reports which locomotion state the character is in. It never moves anything — that split is the whole point, so the thing that decides movement and the thing that describes it stay independent.
useCases: Driving an Animator without the movement code knowing an Animator exists.
Triggering footstep audio or VFX from a state change rather than polling velocity.
Debugging movement by reading a named state instead of raw numbers.

params.tuning: Below this the character reads as idle. Set it just above the drift a controller produces when standing still, or it flickers between idle and walk.
Must be above walkSpeedThreshold. They are not validated against each other.

gotchas.title: It reports state, it does not cause it
gotchas.body: Changing a threshold changes what the state is CALLED, never how fast the character moves. If movement feels wrong, the controller is the place to look.
